thread_text:
Aisha K: OK team — need a compact one-pager for enterprise prospects (CISO/platform leads) + a short webinar script. Goal: security / SLA / deploy-mode decision guidance, plus a 90s benchmark narrative for sales demos. Who can take the one-pager draft?
Tom W: I can do the layout and bullets. do we want two versions — 1-pager for sales, 1-pager for field engineers?
Aisha K: Yes. Sales-facing = single-page exec summary + 3 callouts (SLA, private options, cost story). Field-facing = quick deployment checklist + routing play.
Marta P: Dropped a first-pass copy here: https://drive.redwood/marketing/quickbridge-onepager-v1 (comments on)
Ben R: Quick benchmark numbers for the 90s narrative: P99 latency ~85ms for short-chat loads, throughput 120 req/s on dedicated pool, ~3.1x cost vs baseline but 2.5x throughput density after batching. Use these as illustrative, not claims.
Ravi S: For inbound routing: recommend 3 buckets -> self-serve, SDR follow-up, AE enterprise. Proposed rule: if customer requests "private" OR SLA >= 99.9% -> route to AE; if only compliance question -> SDR then AE.
Tom W: can we show a tiny snippet in the one-pager for the routing logic? like a mini flow.
Aisha K: yes — include mini flow and routing example. Also add a short webinar track: 15m exec case, 20m demo (deploy modes), 15m Q&A.
Marta P: Draft headline options in doc: "Predictable Inference for Regulated Apps" or "Serve LLMs with Security and SLA Confidence" — leaning to second.
Ben R: Suggested benchmark blurb: "Production-grade inference with predictable latency and cost controls — 85ms P99 on typical chat, automated batching reduces token cost by 35% on average."
Ravi S: For lead routing automation here's a sample rule (for launch ops):
```
if request_deploy_mode == 'private' or asks_for_sla >= 99.9:
  route -> AE_enterprise_team
elif mentions_compliance: route -> SDR_security_specialist
else: route -> self-serve_flow
```
Aisha K: Nice. Also need CTA buttons: "Request pilot" (AE), "Start free trial" (self-serve), "Schedule security call" (SDR).
Tom W: Will mock the buttons and add tracking params. Can we confirm UTM pattern?
Marta P: Use utm_source=marketing, utm_campaign=quickbridge_launch, utm_content={cta_label}
Ben R: Also add a short benchmark slide for the webinar deck — one chart: latency distribution + cost delta across modes. I'll prep numbers and CSV.
launch-bot: Webinar scheduled: "QuickBridge: Secure Inference for Regulated Apps" on 2026-06-10 16:00 UTC — registration link https://events.redwood/quickbridge-2026
Aisha K: Perfect. Last ask: everyone add final copy to the doc by EOD Thursday so design can lock Friday.
Tom W: on it, will finish copy edits by Thursday noon.
Marta P: I'll finalize layout and pass to design Friday AM.
Ravi S: I'll add the routing automation snippet to the ops runbook and ping infra to ensure demo envs have private deploy enabled.
Ben R: CSV and charts posted to the doc by Thu 3pm.
Aisha K: Thank you — will do a final pass Friday 10am. :sparkles:
